name: code_parallel
description: Plan work, autonomously repair invalid parallel plans, execute file-disjoint subtasks, and merge their commits.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var raw = $.branch || ('change-' + $.workflowId); var slug = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); if (!/^[a-z]/.test(slug)) slug = 'change-' + slug; return {changeName: slug}; })();

inputParameters.planContext: OpenSpec artifacts under ${openspec_plan.output.changeDir}/ (proposal.md, design.md, specs/**/*.md, tasks.md)

summary.reason: parallel plan remained invalid after autonomous replanning

repoPath.description: Absolute path to an existing local git checkout used as the source repository for this run; fed into model policy resolution and workspace preparation.

instruction.description: Natural-language description of the requested change, used to drive design authoring, OpenSpec/document planning, and (via replan prompts) plan repair.

changeBranch.description: Requested branch/outcome-branch name for the run-owned workspace; a run-suffix is appended for isolated runs. Empty defers to a name derived from the workflow ID.

branchRunId.description: Stable execution ID used to derive the run-owned branch/worktree name; falls back to the workflow ID when empty.

openspecPlanModel.description: Compatibility override: explicit model id forwarded to OpenSpec/document planning and the plan-repair coding-agent session.

openspecMaxTurns.description: Max agent turns forwarded to the OpenSpec/document planning sub-workflow and the plan-repair coding-agent session.

openspecMaxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling forwarded to the OpenSpec/document planning sub-workflow and the plan-repair coding-agent session.

openspecHumanApproval.description: If true, each OpenSpec planning pass is approved via a human WAIT checkpoint; if false, an automated coding-agent judge approves instead.

openspecMaxIterations.description: Maximum number of autonomous plan-repair rounds (and OpenSpec drain-then-review passes) before the plan is rejected/terminated.

codeModel.description: Model identifier passed through unchanged to each parallel subtask fork's coding session, the merge-conflict resolution agent, and the post-merge test-repair session.

codePromptTemplate.description: Prompt template passed through unchanged to each parallel subtask fork and the post-merge test-repair session.

codePromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for codePromptTemplate, passed through unchanged to subtask forks and the post-merge test-repair session.

maxTurns.description: Cap on agent turns for each parallel subtask fork and the post-merge test-repair session.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling for each parallel subtask fork, the merge-conflict resolution agent, and the post-merge test-repair session.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select; empty string defers to the merged policy's default profile.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to a repository model policy file, overriding the default .conductor-code/models.json location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role model overrides merged on top of the selected model profile's roles.

precomputedPlan.description: Caller-supplied parallel plan used verbatim when usePrecomputedPlan is true; must contain a 'subtasks' array of {id, description, files} entries, each file owned by exactly one subtask.

files.description: Repository-relative files owned exclusively by this subtask.

specContextPath.description: Path to a spec/design context file passed through unchanged to each parallel subtask fork.

usePrecomputedPlan.description: When true, skip plan detection/generation entirely and use precomputedPlan as the parallel plan.

design.description: When true, run the design_docs sub-workflow (author/approve design documents) before plan detection.

designDir.description: Repository-relative directory the design agent may write markdown docs into, when design is true.

designHumanApproval.description: When design is true: if true, each design iteration is reviewed by a human WAIT task; if false, an agent design-judge session reviews it.

designMaxIterations.description: Maximum number of author/review iterations before the design loop fails closed, when design is true.

designMaxTurns.description: Maximum agent turns per design-authoring or design-judge session, when design is true.

designMaxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum USD spend per design-authoring or design-judge session, when design is true.

designModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the design-authoring and design-judge sessions, when design is true.

designPromptTemplate.description: Inline prompt template for the design-authoring session, when design is true.

designPromptTemplateSource.description: Provenance label for the design prompt template, when design is true.

inPlace.description: If true, prepare the run-owned workspace inside repoPath itself instead of a separate worktree.

workspacePath.description: Existing worktree path to inherit unchanged (nested-workflow case); when set, no new branch or worktree is created.

contextPaths.description: Absolute filesystem paths granted as read-only live context to the design session, the document-plan session, and each parallel subtask fork.

maxFixAttempts.description: Upper bound on structured fix/commit/re-test passes performed by the post-merge test_cycle sub-workflow.

agentCompleted.description: Always true; a literal completion marker for this workflow output (distinct from any single agent session's own status).

branch.description: Branch checked out in the prepared workspace, from workspace_prepare.

changeBranch.description: Same value as 'branch'; the workspace's checked-out branch.

conflicts.description: Branches that produced merge conflicts during merge_remediation, regardless of whether they were later resolved.

groupIds.description: Comma-separated list of subtask ids that were turned into parallel forks, in order.

mergeCostUsd.description: USD cost of the merge_remediation sub-workflow's conflict-resolution agent calls.

merged.description: Branches merged cleanly by merge_remediation with no conflicts.

planMode.description: Which planning path produced the parallel plan for this run.

proposalText.description: Human-readable plan summary: the fixed precomputed-plan label, the document_plan summary, or (on the openspec path) always null because this field is wired to a 'proposalText' output that openspec_plan does not actually produce.

sourceHandoff.description: Bookkeeping proving the final candidate commit matches what was verified and handed off.

baselineCommit.description: Commit capturing the source's Git-visible changes at workspace-prepare time.

branch.description: Branch confirmed by the final in-place guard check to still be checked out.

commit.description: HEAD commit confirmed by the final in-place guard check.

executionOutcome.description: Fine-grained verdict folding plan validity, merge state, and delivery outcome.

includedSourcePaths.description: Paths included in the workspace baseline snapshot/commit.

originalBranch.description: The branch the source checkout was on before workspace preparation.

originalHead.description: The source checkout's HEAD commit before workspace preparation.

presented.description: True only when the verified candidate exactly matches what the in-place guard confirmed and the verification outcome passed.

repoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the checkout confirmed by the final in-place guard check.

verificationAttempts.description: Number of plan-repair loop iterations executed.

verificationState.description: Coarse verification verdict, same value set as executionOutcome.

files.description: Repository-relative files owned exclusively by this subtask.

subtasks.description: The final validated, file-disjoint parallel plan that was executed.

summary.description: Always null: wired to 'aggregate.output.result', a field code_parallel_aggregate_usage does not produce (its output has no 'result' property).

totalCostUsd.description: Sum of planning, subtask, merge, and verification USD costs, from code_parallel_aggregate_usage.

totalTokens.description: Sum of planning, subtask, merge, and verification token usage, from code_parallel_aggregate_usage.

verification.description: Fixed snapshot recorded only on the successful (plan-accepted) path; the plan_rejected path terminates the workflow early with its own differently-shaped output instead.

issues.description: Plan validation issues recorded by the final plan check (empty when the plan validated cleanly).

deliveryOutcome.description: Same verdict as verificationState: plan validity, merge state, and delivery outcome folded together.

deliveryReports.description: Normalized per-subtask delivery report, one per parallel fork, from code_parallel_delivery_summary.

missingPaths.description: De-duplicated union of missingPaths across all subtask delivery reports.

rejectedPaths.description: De-duplicated union of rejectedPaths across all subtask delivery reports.

commandFailures.description: Concatenation of every subtask's commandFailures entries (not de-duplicated).

sandboxDenials.description: De-duplicated union of sandboxDenials across all subtask delivery reports.

deliveryRepairAttempts.description: Sum of repair attempts across all subtask delivery reports.

verificationAttempts.description: Same value as deliveryRepairAttempts: sum of repair attempts across all subtask delivery reports.

verificationChecks.description: Fixed snapshot identical in shape to 'verification', recorded only on the successful (plan-accepted) path.

verificationCommit.description: Final candidate commit SHA, after merge selection and any post-merge test-cycle repair advanced it.

verificationFindings.description: Plan validation issues from the final plan check (same as verification.issues).

verificationReport.description: Human-readable verification summary: branch/commit, plan validity, merge count, execution outcome, and plan issues.

verificationState.description: Coarse verdict folding plan validity, merge state, and delivery outcome.

verified.description: True only when the plan was valid, the merge state was 'merged', and delivery state was 'passed'.

testCycleState.description: Terminal state of the post-merge test_cycle sub-workflow (optional task; may be absent if it did not run).

testsPassed.description: True when the post-merge test_cycle reported tests_passed or no_tests_required.

testRunCount.description: Total number of test verification runs performed by the post-merge test_cycle, including repair re-tests.

testReport.description: Human-readable one-line summary from the post-merge test_cycle sub-workflow.
